statement: For each of four frozen held-out masks, the table records the lowest independently evaluated weighted peak upper bound among the locally generated feasible 16-element equal-amplitude 6-bit phase-only candidates. These are model witnesses and best-of-local-portfolio values, not global optima or literature records.
status: Local proposal, author checked; no maintainer or scientific acceptance
scope: isotropic-ula-phase-v1, 3 GHz, 16 fixed half-wavelength elements; eta>=0.85, HPBW_u<=0.14, pointing_error_u<=0.015; fixed exclusion +/-0.15u and protected sectors; float64 curvature enclosures, no hardware inference

assumptions.statement: Scalar isotropic uncoupled far-field elements; hardware behavior is unverified.
Analytical curvature bound evaluated in float64 with padding, without directed-rounding proof.
No global optimum or novelty verified; literature does not supply an optimum for this exact benchmark.

prerequisites: Install requirements.lock.txt into an isolated venv; see README.md
